payload.subject:
Defect: IBR observe and extract omit inputs with ARIA role searchbox or combobox.

Plugin: plugins/ibr -> /Users/tyroneross/dev/git-folder/interface-built-right
Affected tools: observe, extract

Reproduction:
1. Open https://atomize-ai.vercel.app and open the search dialog.
2. Run the IBR observe MCP tool.
3. Observe that it lists 28 elements limited to buttons and links; the search field is absent.
4. Run the IBR extract MCP tool.
5. Observe that it reports 0 inputs.
6. Inspect the DOM and confirm <input type=search aria-label="Search query"> exists.
7. Run queryAXTree fill using the accessible name Search query; it succeeds at 0.95 confidence.

Expected: observe and extract include fillable elements exposed as searchbox or combobox, with accessible role and name.
Actual: both collectors omit the existing, resolvable search input.
Evidence: observe returned 28 button/link elements only; extract returned 0 inputs; the DOM contained the search input; queryAXTree resolved and filled Search query at 0.95 confidence.
Impact: agents wrongly conclude that otherwise testable applications are untestable.
Fix direction: include searchbox and combobox roles in the observe and extract element collectors.
Acceptance: the Atomize search field appears in both outputs by role and accessible name, queryAXTree behavior remains intact, and existing input/button/link collection does not regress.

Defect: IBR flow_search reports successful type and submit steps while the target input remains empty, and it cannot resolve the input by aria-label.

Plugin: plugins/ibr -> /Users/tyroneross/dev/git-folder/interface-built-right
Affected tool: flow_search

Reproduction:
1. Open https://atomize-ai.vercel.app and open the search dialog.
2. Run flow_search against the search input with a query value.
3. Inspect the step results: type and submit report success, and the type step reports duration 0ms.
4. Inspect the screenshots emitted by the flow: the input still displays its placeholder after the reported type success, showing that the value remains empty.
5. Target the field by aria-label Search query and observe that flow_search cannot find it.
6. Confirm that queryAXTree can resolve the same accessible name at 0.95 confidence.

Expected: flow_search resolves the input by accessible name, verifies the post-type DOM value, and only reports type or downstream submit success when the requested value is present.
Actual: it emits false success for type and submit while its screenshot shows an unchanged empty input; aria-label targeting also fails.
Evidence: flow output reports type success with duration 0ms; its own post-type screenshot still shows the placeholder; queryAXTree resolves Search query at 0.95 confidence.
Impact: agents trust a completed search flow even though no query was entered, producing false validation results.
Fix direction: add post-type value verification to flow steps and reuse the queryAXTree resolver for accessible-name targeting.
Acceptance: aria-label Search query resolves; the typed value is read back before success; a mismatch returns failure with the observed value; submit does not report success when typing failed.
